facts.fact: 本章仍是 Saskia 的限知视角：Lucy 刚承认自己杀了两个男人，Saskia 的第一反应是不敢相信这句话真的说出口了。
facts.anchor: That is the last thing on Earth Saskia expected Lucy to say.

facts.fact: Saskia 追问了一句，Lucy 没有收回，而是站起来从背后抱住她。
facts.anchor: “I’m sorry, what did you just say?” Saskia asks.

facts.fact: Saskia 早已怀疑自己体内扎根的种子，就是她一直种在 Greg 与 Nate 上面的那些菜。
facts.anchor: She has long suspected that they are cabbage and carrot and radishes, the vegetables she keeps planted over Greg and Nate.

facts.fact: 埋尸种菜这件事是支配她生活的秘密，她原本打算永不告诉任何人。
facts.anchor: This is the secret that controls her life, and she did not anticipate telling anyone, ever.

facts.fact: Lucy 贴着 Saskia 的耳朵低声承认：十四岁那年她杀了自己的母亲。
facts.anchor: “I killed my mother when I was fourteen,” Lucy whispers, sending chills down Saskia’s spine for multiple reasons.

facts.fact: 母亲十五岁生下她，后来成了瘾者。
facts.anchor: She had me when she was fifteen, and she became a drug addict.

facts.fact: 母亲对她时好时坏：有时像最好的朋友，有时虐待她。
facts.anchor: Some days, she acted like we were best friends, and other days, she abused me.

facts.fact: 母亲翻遍她的房间，找到并拿走她藏起来的全部现金。
facts.anchor: She found all the cash I’d hidden. Every dollar.

facts.fact: 母亲深夜回家的那晚，她气得睡不着，随后溜进母亲房间拿了枕头。
facts.anchor: I was so furious I couldn’t sleep.

facts.fact: 第二天早上祖父发现尸体，什么都没说，但心里已经知道是她做的。
facts.anchor: But my grandfather found her the next morning, and he didn’t say anything, but somehow, he knew.

facts.fact: 她放学回家，发现通向外面的每扇门都装上了带钥匙的锁。
facts.anchor: When I got home, there were keyed locks on every door that led outside.

facts.fact: 每扇窗都被钉死，可能被当作武器的东西也被收走。
她找到保险箱密码，把祖父手写的、记录她罪行的自述冲进马桶。
facts.anchor: I found the code to the safe and flushed his handwritten account of my sins into the toilet in a thousand tiny pieces.

facts.fact: 章末 Saskia 小心地问：那不是心脏病发，对吧。
facts.anchor: “It wasn’t a heart attack, was it?” Saskia asks carefully.
